measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework using Structural Equation Models (SEM) to expose assumptions in AI benchmarks, using cross-lingual alignment transfer between English and Danish as a case study. The measured constructs are 'language ability', 'cultural knowledge', and 'alignment' (Harmless, Helpful, Honest).
